headline: Tanzania Financial Markets Week to 13 November 2026: 10-Year Bond Yield Falls to 10.1406%, Shilling Eases to TZS 2,644.49/USD
summary: Tanzania's 10-year Treasury bond yield fell to 10.1406% from 10.6924% in the week to 13 November 2026. The shilling eased 0.15% to TZS 2,644.49 per US dollar, and the 7-day interbank rate dipped to 6.34%.
why: Government bond yields set the cost of sovereign borrowing and anchor pricing across the local financial system. The shilling's exchange rate affects import costs and returns for foreign investors in Tanzanian assets.
